This site is a palace of the mind — my personal vault, walked through room by room. Feel free to skim.

Why does this exist? Sharing knowledge is how we work together for a better future, isn’t it? Why waste time finding out what someone else figured out already. This is part of the blueprint for Human Augmented Intelligence.

How to get around

  • The constellation on the home page is the vault’s live graph — click it to open the observatory and see how everything connects.
  • The sidebar/explorer lists every room (folder). A folder’s note (folder/folder.md) gives context on what’s inside before you dig in.
  • [[wikilinks]] connect notes to each other — click through, that’s the point.
  • Search, dark mode, and reader mode toggles live in the toolbar.

Start here

  • Meaning — probably the most relevant
  • why you should write
  • Alignement — how I try to stay coherent
  • Travel
  • Friends
  • Work - some good output of it is here
  • Guides
  • Clippings
  • Books — the library, borrow anything

Folders have a folder note under the same name that gives extra context on them.
